# BEES HUB FARMLAND PRIVATE LIMITED — Full Reference (`llms-full.txt`)

> Bees Hub Farmland is an agricultural products manufacturer, B2C ecommerce storefront, and B2B wholesale & private-label supplier headquartered in Nagercoil, Kanyakumari District, Tamil Nadu, India.

## Verified Legal Entity & Credentials
- **Legal Entity**: BEES HUB FARMLAND PRIVATE LIMITED

- **FSSAI Central License**: 12425009000671
- **GSTIN**: 33AAOCB0453D1Z3 (State Code: 33 – Tamil Nadu)

- **Quality & Safety Certifications**: GMP & Organic Certified Operations, ISO 9001:2015 & ISO 22000:2018

- **Email**: admin@beeshubfarmland.com
- **Website**: https://beeshubfarmland.com

## Product Categories & Core Offerings
1. **Natural Honey**: Raw, unheated Pure Forest Honey harvested from Western Ghats apiaries; moisture controlled under 19%; batch COA and C4/NMR sugar purity tested. Retail packs (500g, 1kg) and bulk 30kg/50kg/300kg drums.
2. **Superfood & Dehydrated Powders**: Solar-dehydrated below 50°C and milled to 80–100 mesh with zero maltodextrin or added cane sugar:
   - Natural Dates Powder
   - Caffeine-Free Dates Coffee Powder
   - Nendran Banana Powder
   - Red Banana Powder
   - Moringa Leaf Powder
   - Beetroot Powder, Carrot Powder, Sweet Potato Powder, Pineapple Powder
3. **Cold-Pressed Oils**: Traditional Marachekku wood-pressed below 45°C:
   - Cold-Pressed Virgin Coconut Oil
   - Cold-Pressed Sesame Oil
   - Cold-Pressed Groundnut Oil
4. **Natural Food Ingredients & Other Farm Products**:
   - Organic Jaggery Powder, Black Dry Dates, Himalayan Pink Salt, Black Salt
   - Jumbo Fox Nut Makhana (Grade 5 & Grade 6), Moringa Capsules, Botanical Herbal Soaps

## B2B Services & Minimum Order Quantities (MOQ)
- **Bulk Raw Honey Drums**: Starting MOQ 50 kg (available in 30kg, 50kg, and 300kg food-grade drums).
- **Bulk Superfood Powders**: Starting MOQ 25 kg lots in moisture-proof liner cartons.
- **Private Label & Custom Bottling** (`https://beeshubfarmland.com/private-label`): Pilot MOQ from 100 units in Square, Hexa, Octa, and ITC glass jar series.
- **Wedding & Corporate Gift Hampers** (`https://beeshubfarmland.com/gift`): Custom laser-engraved pine-wood chests starting from 25 units.

## Retail Storefront Policies
- **Payment Methods**: Razorpay Online Payments (UPI, Cards, NetBanking) and Cash on Delivery (COD) where enabled.
- **Shipping**: Retail storefront orders currently qualify for free shipping across India. Live order status can be checked via the Track Order tool.
- **Returns & Refunds**: Support for damaged, leaked, or incorrect items via admin@beeshubfarmland.com or +91 95787 84431 with Order ID and packaging photos.
